analysis: Two files changed. (1) .github/workflows/docs-impact.yml line 43 (head side) adds `ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}` to the docs-impact checkout. The trigger is still `pull_request`, with no secrets, default read-only token, and no pull_request_target. The job already ran PR-controlled scripts from the merge ref, so checking out the head SHA adds no new privilege or secret exposure. It only makes the validated tree match the PR head rather than the synthetic merge commit. DOCS_IMPACT_BASE still comes from the base SHA. The CI contribution-policy workflow is outside the runtime threat model assets (it is the release supply chain, listed out of scope), so I raised no finding. (2) CHANGELOG.md adds a provider 0.9.17 note under `Unreleased` about honoring an explicit TMPDIR for anonymous runtime metallib snapshots. The note claims unlink-before-copy, digest binding, and failure without fallback. No provider source is in this diff, so that claim is unverified and a later pass should check it if the provider change appears. The note relates to TB-003 and TB-009 only indirectly, and it is documentation only, so there is no direct security behavior change here. No coordinator, provider, attestation, App Attest, or billing code changed. Coverage limit: the underlying provider TMPDIR code is not in this batch.
